name: Link
description: Text link that leads to another page, section or resource. It is a native inline `<a>`, using the theme's accent color. Size and weight adapt so it fits the surrounding text.

dos: Use a label that says where it leads: "View pricing", not "Click here".
Inside a paragraph, use the same `size` as the surrounding text.
Use `underline` when the link sits inside running text: color alone is not enough to distinguish it.
Use `highContrast` when the accent color does not give enough contrast against the background.
If it opens another tab (`target="_blank"`), say so in the label or with text hidden for screen readers.

donts.why: A link navigates; a button runs an action. They are announced differently and activated with different keys.

donts.case: Link without href (to make it "do" something with JavaScript)
donts.why: An `<a>` without href is not focusable and is not announced as a link.

donts.useInstead: IconButton (if it is an action) or Link with visible text
donts.why: Without a label there is no accessible name; the Figma Link always has text.

donts.case: Several consecutive links with the same label ("Read more")
donts.useInstead: Different labels that describe the destination
donts.why: A screen reader that lists links cannot tell them apart.

related.difference: Runs an action; the link navigates.

props.name: size
props.description: Text size: 12 / 14 / 16 / 18 / 20 / 24 / 28 / 35 / 60 px, with its line height. In code, the default is 3 (body text). Figma marks 1 as the component set value, but that is only the file's initial value.

props.name: weight
props.description: Font weight. regular by default; the component set's initial value in Figma is light.

props.name: underline
props.description: If true, shows the fixed underline (1px) below the text, in color accent-alpha.5. In Figma it is the `underline` axis with values false / true.

props.name: highContrast
props.description: If true, uses step 12 of the accent scale instead of accent-alpha.11 for the text.

props.name: href
props.description: Link destination. Required: without href an `<a>` is not a link. Code only.

props.name: target
props.description: Where it opens. With '_blank', the component adds rel="noopener noreferrer". Code only.

props.name: children
props.description: Link text. Default text in Figma: "Link".

root.description: Root element. Always a native `<a>` with href.
root.figmaLayer: Link (each variant of the component set)

underline.description: 1px underline below the text. In code it is `text-decoration`, not an element. Only with underline=true.

height.note: Height = line height of the text style per size (no padding). There is no dedicated token: it comes from text-style.{size}.{weight}.

modes.hug: Fits the text. Always; there is no fill or fixed.

a11y.role: link (implicit from the a element with href)
a11y.name: The link text (children). It must make sense out of context.
a11y.focusIndicator: Focus ring visible with :focus-visible. Not in Figma: use the system's same ring (outer colors.accent.accent-alpha.8 and inner colors.accent.accent.3).
a11y.minTarget: Inline link in text: exempt from 2.5.8. If it sits alone in a row, its clickable area should be ≥ 24px tall.
a11y.contrastNote: Text accent-alpha.11 (or accent.12 with highContrast) on the background: ≥ 4.5:1 for normal text. Without underline, color is not enough as the only indicator (WCAG 1.4.1). Not measured in Figma.

label.voice: Says where it leads: "View pricing", not "Click here".

whenTargetBlank.announce: Warn that it opens in another tab

cases: renders an `<a>` with the given href; without href it fails in TypeScript
highContrast uses colors.accent.accent.12 on the text
underline=true paints the underline with colors.accent.accent-alpha.5

needsReview: Figma designs only 4 properties: size (1-9), weight (light, regular, medium, bold), underline and highContrast. 144 variants. There are no states (hover, focus, visited) and no color axis.
The component set's default values in Figma are size=1 and weight=light. The contract uses size=3 and weight=regular (body text). My decision, not Figma's: review.
There is no color in Figma: the link is always from the accent scale. Real Radix accepts `color` on the component; it was not added because Figma does not design it.

underline is a boolean in Figma (false / true). Real Radix has underline: auto, always, hover and none; this was neither designed nor included. Hover has no design: decide whether the underline appears on mouse over.
The underline is a 1px rectangle placed right below the text box (y = height). In code it will be done with text-decoration; the thickness and offset may differ slightly.
The underline color (accent-alpha.5) is the same with highContrast=true and false.
No focus or hover designed: the contract's focus ring was copied from Button, not from Figma.
Letter spacing: in Figma the Typography/9/Light style uses -0.04 and the other weights -0.4 (same anomaly already noted in the text-styles).
Figma uses SF Pro; in code the font is the theme's (typography.font-family).
Not in Figma: href, target. The width depends on the sample text "Link".
